flags.message: Forward-mode retrieval of this docket's own post-baseline entries was decisive: the Supreme Court docket page shows the United States' CVSG brief filed 2026-09-15, and the brief recommends that the petition be granted. The provisioned snapshot (2026-05-19) predates it, as expected for a forward cell. The petition itself remains pending and undistributed as of 2026-09-18, so no outcome was seen. Flagged so the evaluator can see that the forecast conditions on the SG's recommendation rather than on the snapshot alone.
